ref-article-001.body:
![harbour](/media/harbour.png)


The reading room on the east quay opened its doors again on 12 April 2025. Volunteers repaired the shelves and brought the long oak table back into use.


## A room for everyone


There is no membership fee. Bring a book, borrow one from the shelf, or sit beside the window with a cup of tea.


> We wanted a quiet place that still belongs to everyone.
>
> Mara Holm, volunteer


Find opening hours in our [guide to visiting](/guides/visiting/).

ref-article-002.body:
![garden](/media/garden.png)


On 3 May 2025, neighbours brought 18 packets of seeds to the shared garden. Each packet carried the variety, harvest year, and a short note from its grower.


## What to bring next time


- Dry seeds in a labelled paper envelope.
- The year you collected them.
- A note about the conditions they grew in.


Keep a small reserve for gaps in the beds. Our [seed calculator](/guides/seed-calculator/) includes a 20% reserve.

ref-guide-001.body:
The reading room is at 8 East Quay in our fictional harbour neighbourhood.


## Opening hours


- Tuesday and Thursday: 10:00 to 17:00.
- Saturday: 10:00 to 14:00.
- Closed on other days.


## Access

The quay entrance has step-free access. A quiet table and an accessible toilet are on the ground floor. Assistance dogs are welcome.
